subject: Install INLA on MacBook Pro with M1 chip and R 4.2.1

messages.author: ab3857f95c4d14eb
messages.subject: Install INLA on MacBook Pro with M1 chip and R 4.2.1
parts:
I am trying to install INLA on my MacBook, but getting this message, and wondering if I am doing something wrong, or if my setup is no yet supported:

Warning in install.packages :
  unable to access index for repository https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/stable/src/contrib:
  Line starting '<!doctype html> ...' is malformed!
Warning in install.packages :
  unable to access index for repository https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/testing/src/contrib:
  Line starting '<!doctype html> ...' is malformed!
Warning in install.packages :
  package ‘INLA’ is not available for this version of R

A version of this package for your version of R might be available elsewhere,
see the ideas at
https://cran.r-project.org/doc/manuals/r-patched/R-admin.html#Installing-packages
Warning in install.packages :
  unable to access index for repository https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/stable/bin/macosx/big-sur-arm64/contrib/4.2:
  Line starting '<!doctype html> ...' is malformed!
Warning in install.packages :
  unable to access index for repository https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/testing/bin/macosx/big-sur-arm64/contrib/4.2:
  Line starting '<!doctype html> ...' is malformed!

- Keith

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Install INLA on MacBook Pro with M1 chip and R 4.2.1
parts:
try the testing version ? You may have gotten this error while the
package was updating which might leave the index malformed for a short
ammount of time
